provider: OVHcloud Object Storage One-Zone Standard (Poland subsidiary)

free_tier.stated: No free tier: the Standard class in a 1-AZ (One Zone) region is billed from the first GiB at 0,00004861 PLN per GiB-hour (about 0,0354853 PLN per GiB-month) on the Polish price list, one rate at every volume
free_tier.notes: billed per GiB-hour; the monthly figure is the hourly price x 730 hours

per_object_cap.stated: 48 TiB per object through multipart upload (up to 10,000 parts of 5 MiB to 5 GiB); 5 GiB through a single PUT
per_object_cap.notes: the Object Storage technical limits page states one set of limits for the Object Storage offer

retention.stated: unlimited time: objects are kept until deleted, and the Standard class has no minimum storage duration
retention.notes: the price table marks the Standard minimum storage billed N/A

egress.terms: Free: the Polish price list marks external ingoing and outgoing traffic, internal traffic, data retrieval and API requests «Darmowy» (free) on the One Zone Standard row

tooling: rclone `s3` (any S3 client), s3cmd, aws-cli, boto3, restic/borg via rclone. Live endpoints probed: s3.waw.io.cloud.ovh.net -> 307, s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net -> 307, s3.rbx.io.cloud.ovh.net -> 307 (all answer with an S3 XML 307 to the product page, i.e. the clusters are up and addressing buckets by region).
chaining: Unbounded — a bucket has no plan size, so 10 TiB and 20 TiB are the same product at the same rate. No tier break at all until the 3-AZ Standard 50 TiB step.

limits.value: 48 TiB per object by multipart upload; 5 GiB by a single PUT
300 PUT and 900 GET requests per second per bucket, soft defaults

limits_note: One Zone Infrequent Access is 0,00002367 PLN per GiB-hour (about 0,0172791 PLN per GiB-month) with a 30-day minimum storage duration and 0,01728 PLN per GiB retrieved; the Standard class has neither

identity_cost.detail: an email address validated by a one-time code, the country of tax residence, and a valid payment method on the account before the first Public Cloud project; Visa, Mastercard and Maestro cards are accepted, and PayPal and a prepaid account are offered as payment methods

reliability_note: Warsaw (WAW) is listed without 3-AZ: the 3-AZ regions are Paris and Milan, so Object Storage bought in Warsaw is a single-zone deployment
confidence_note: documented: the Polish and international price lists, the storage classes page, the Object Storage technical limits page, the account-creation guide and the free-trial page were read and quoted on 2026-10-30; a read timed from a bucket would make it measured

price_per_tb_month: PLN 33.05 per TB per month (PLN 0.0354853 per GiB-month x 931.32 GiB per TB); one rate at every volume
notes: Unlimited / unbilled minimum: «Możesz przechowywać dowolną ilość danych, nie określamy minimalnego wolumenu». Billed per GiB-hour at 0.00004861 PLN, shown as ~0.0354853 PLN/GiB/month over 730 h.

extras.price_verbatim: One-Zone Standard: $9.34/TB/mo ($112.03/TB/yr) with free egress, free API calls, free retrieval — identical at 5 TB and 20 TB because pricing is strictly per-GiB with no tiers. One-Zone Infrequent Access: $4.55/TB/mo storage but +$2.27/TB per full read-back (0.01728 PLN/GiB) and a 30-day minimum, so $6.82/TB/mo effective on one read = $81.83/TB/yr. 3-AZ Standard: $16.07/TB/mo, first 50 TiB. Swift Standard: $12.68/TB/mo. All PLN converted at 0.256916 USD/PLN and 1024 GiB/TB.

binding_note: none: storage has no stated cap, an object may reach 48 TiB, the per-bucket rates of 300 PUT and 900 GET requests per second are soft defaults, and the 1 Gbps per connection is lifted by parallel connections
